finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::scope creep beyond the originating issue. docs/tasks/active/20260806-cli-status-ctx-structured-output-todo.md (#635) scopes this work to routing `status`/`ctx list` through `output()` and validating `--format`; the diff additionally lands a cross-package oauth protocol change (per-attempt nonce in `cli-auth.store`, guard, callback redirect, loopback server hardening), a csv formula-injection transform, and a `cells batch` parse restructure. each is a separable change with its own risk surface (the oauth one even introduces a backend/cli version coupling), bundled into an output-formatting pr.
evidence: The claim's factual assertions check out against the diff as supplied. The todo file's "Approach" (docs/tasks/active/20260806-cli-status-ctx-structured-output-todo.md, the six numbered steps) scopes #635 to `parseOutputFormat`, `status`, `ctx list`, the schema registry, tests and doc touch-ups, yet the same PR lands a cross-package OAuth protocol change (`packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts` `createLoginNonce`/`nonceMatches`/`startCallbackServer` nonce+Origin+method checks, `packages/backend/src/auth/github-auth.guard.ts` `parseCliNonce`, `cli-auth.store.ts` `nonce` field, `auth.controller.ts` `stateParam` echo), a CSV formula-neutralization transform with a new required `CsvOptions` (`packages/cli/src/output/csv.ts`), and a restructure of `cells batch` JSON parsing. The version-coupling risk it names is real and is acknowledged in the PR's own docs ("a CLI at this version or later needs a backend at this version or later"). The claim does not misread anything; the only nuance is that the todo file itself records these as round-2 panel requests, which explains rather than refutes the bundling. Impact is process/reviewability rather than user-visible incorrectness, so I rate it minor.
